messages:
elena: Heads-up — scheduling enablement of model `silkroad-7b` into the catalog during the 2025-06-02 22:00 UTC change window. Targets: `web-chat` and `search-embeddings` routes only. Canary plan: 5% for 30m, then 25% ramp if stable. Fallback ordering: silkroad-7b -> atlas-6b-quant -> atlas-6b -> legacy. Rollback triggers: p95 latency > +200ms vs baseline, error rate >2%, or eval quality drop >4pts. Pin list and runbook snippet below. Please ack and shout out any objections or missing checks. @matt @jin :white_check_mark:

matt: Ack. 5%/30m sounds good. I'll create a telemetry tag `silkroad-canary` and surface p95/p99 + error-rate dashboards. Also add an SLO guard at 20% over baseline to alert infra-oncall.

jin: I'll run a staging dry-run and validate the pin/drain steps. Deploybot will execute pin -> drain -> enable, right? Do we want an explicit warmup before canary? :coffee:

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled job `silkroad-7b-staging-dryrun` at 2025-06-02T20:30Z. status: queued. Use `deploybot status <job>` to follow.

tara: Recommend pre-warm KV/cache on the model fleet. Suggest running ~1k short prompts against the web-chat route for 10m prior to the canary to populate KV and reduce first-token variance.

kevin: If latency spikes, rollback path should be: immediate traffic pin to `atlas-6b-quant` then rollout halt. Rollback authorization: infra-oncall + eng-releases lead. Add that to runbook so we don't wait for PM.

matt: Pushing runbook snippet to ops-runbooks now:
```
canary:
  percentage: 5
  duration: 30m
metrics:
  - latency.p95
  - errors.rate
  - model.eval_delta
rollback_triggers:
  p95_latency_delta: +200ms
  error_rate_percent: 2
  eval_drop_points: 4
rollback_owners:
  - @jin
  - @matt
  - @elena
steps:
  - deploybot pin silkroad-7b --routes web-chat,search-embeddings
  - run warmup sequence (manual or k8s job)
  - deploybot enable-canary 5%
  - monitor 0-30m
  - if trigger -> deploybot rollback-to atlas-6b-quant
```

deploybot: deploybot: dry-run completed. result: pin sequence validated, no config errors detected. Note: warmup step flagged as NOT_RUN — please execute prior to enabling canary.

jin: Got it. I'll kick the warmup at T-10m and then trigger deploybot to start the 5% canary. Will tag charts with `silkroad-canary`.

elena: PM signoff received this morning. @matt please kick at 22:00UTC. After the 30m canary post a short release note in this thread with the outcome and any deviations. :rocket:

kevin: Ack. I'll be watching p95 and error rate and will escalate if either crosses threshold. Rollback ready if needed.

matt: Acknowledged. I'll start the job and post back at +30m. If stable we'll proceed to 25% ramp and update the catalog pin list.
